---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
---

Security problems go through a private advisory, not an issue (see SECURITY.md).

- Versions: antlion-lacewing, lacewing, Node, OS
- Framework and replay store (memory, Redis, Postgres, your own)
- The request, with tokens and proofs removed or replaced by their decoded headers and claims
- The `error.code` you got, and what you expected
